findings.claim: The last language record (CORRECTED, 2026-08-25) was written against an artifact whose Q1 is not the shipped Q1. The shipped Q1 prompt and all four option strings were authored by the pedagogy stage AFTER the language pass and have never been read by a language reviewer in this round; CORRECTED therefore overstates coverage by a quarter of the graded surface.
findings.evidence: candidates-corrected/las-b14-003.json (the language stage's own output, mtime 17:29:07) carries q1 prompt "Vad var, enligt texten, utmärkande för blocken som togs upp ur Sävlången?" with options "De sågades till en bestämd tjocklek…" / "De vägde alltid omkring hundrafemtio kilo…" / "De hade ett givet mått i fyrkant…" / "De märktes med firmans stämpel…". candidates-final/las-b14-003.json (mtime 17:45:35) ships q1 prompt "Vad var, enligt texten, utmärkande för hur Lorentzon & Kompani sålde sin is?" with four wholly different strings. reviews/language.jsonl mtime 17:29:29, reviews/pedagogy.jsonl mtime 17:34:38 (its note: "the 2026-07-30 q1 re-anchor onto the firms invented lass-not-kilo trading convention was re-applied ... q1 option TEXT changed"). The language stage's two real 08-25 edits were both outside q1: "osäkert som förebild" → "osäkert som avbild" in q2 option C, and "den vänder Frödells egen position bakåt" → "den vänder på Frödells egen position" in the q2 rationale; both survive into candidates-final.
findings.why: Coverage gap, not a live defect: I ran the native-expert probe on the shipped q1 myself and find no calque, agreement, register or spelling defect — "Firman sålde i lass i stället för i kilo, en ordning som gynnade säljaren ju längre det led på sommaren", "göra rätt för sig med smör eller andra varor" and "vägde varje lass på stadsvågen före leverans" are all idiomatic, and "i lass … i kilo" mirrors the passage's own "skrev sina kontrakt i lass och inte i kilo". Does not block ship; the record should say what it actually covered.

findings.claim: Both open G-SPRAK vote-3 minors on the passage survive verbatim into the shipping file, through two CORRECTED language records (2026-07-30 and 2026-08-25), with no disposition written anywhere. The language stage never edited the passage at all.
findings.evidence: Shipped passage still reads "lät 2011 återuppföra ishuset vid Långudden på den gamla grunden och efter ritningen från 1889, och fyllde det tre vintrar i rad med is från Sävlången" (G-SPRAK-3 finding: "class 3: the prepositional object is stranded after the duration adverbial, producing a garden-path reading ('i rad med is'). Native alternative: 'fyllde det med is från Sävlången tre vintrar i rad'.") and "Huset stod kvar till 1968 och revs för en badplats." ("class 6: 'revs för en badplats' is compressed; 'riva för' does not carry the purpose sense on its own."). SHA1 of the passage string is identical in candidates/las-b14-003.json, candidates-corrected/las-b14-003.json and candidates-final/las-b14-003.json (0b84b41a1f14…, 5031 chars), so no passage byte was ever touched. reviews/language.jsonl carries no note on either line.
findings.why: Held minor and not a refutation: the flag is a split vote (claude-opus-5/G-SPRAK-3 returned pass on the same passage, and both models passed at votes 1 and 2), and on my own read only the first is a clear native-editor fix — "revs för en badplats" is compressed but attested. Neither touches a key or a fact. The gap is that a flagged-and-declined finding was never recorded as declined.

findings.claim: A stems-internal cross-question corroboration runs from Q2's option set to Q4's key and no review stage has ever dispositioned it, although 'cross-question leak' is named in the integrated remit and the gate that found it filed it major with blind_pick == the shipped key.
findings.evidence: Q2's options disclose the modern trial without the passage: "Det återuppförda huset är tätare än de gamla ishusen var", "Ritningen från 1889 tycks avvika från det hus som verkligen stod vid Långudden", "Tre vintrars mätningar kan aldrig ge besked om hur ett ishus fungerade under en hel epok." Q4 then asks about "Lorentzons regel från 1901" with key B "Den skrevs ned utan mätningar men fick stöd av ett försök mer än hundra år senare." and distractor D "Den formulerades sedan en tidig mätserie visat hur mycket is en låg stapel förlorade över sommaren." — D is undercut by Q2's modern-reconstruction framing while A falls to its double absolute ("den enda regel", "samtliga firmor"). verdicts-vfinal/verdicts-gstem.jsonl line 13 (executed_by claude-opus-4-8/G-STEM-b14repair): q:4 verdict flag, severity major, blind_classification PARTIALLY, blind_pick "B", note "the lean to B rests on a cross-question corroboration the orchestrator should see: within this stems sheet q:2 dates the corroborating trial to a modern reconstruction ('tre vintrars mätningar', a 1889 drawing rebuilt), which supports B's 'ett försök mer än hundra år senare' and undercuts D's early measurement series preceding the rule." The same run flagged q:3 with blind_pick "D" (= key). reviews/integrated.jsonl's las-b14-003 lines read "post-repair sweep" and (2026-08-25) no note at all; reviews/pedagogy.jsonl's 08-25 note mentions only q1, the q3 distractor framing and the skeptic_slot count.
findings.why: Real but partial, hence minor: Q2 leaks only the trial's existence and date, never B's actual assertion that the trial SUPPORTED the rule, so the lean narrows Q4 to B-vs-C rather than isolating B; and the two fresh G-STEM voters in this session's verdicts.jsonl (claude-opus-4-8/G-STEM and claude-opus-5/G-STEM) both return pass on q:2, q:3 and q:4. The house treated this exact class as repair-worthy in batch11 (commit e771817), so it should be dispositioned in writing rather than left silent.

findings.claim: The unit asserts every name is invented, and the batch record clears the byline as unattested, but that clearance could not be re-verified in this session and the byline is the citation form of a plausibly real Swedish researcher surname. Re-verification is owed before ship, given that the same stage renamed weaker collisions in the sibling units of this very batch.
findings.evidence: Passage byline: "— M. Tannerfeldt". generator_meta.self_blind_solve: "All entities are fictional (Sävlången, Mörtsjön, Hulterud, Långudden, Lorentzon & Kompani, Fabian Lorentzon, Yngve Frödell, Vendela Karnstedt, M. Tannerfeldt)". Precedent in the same batch: reviews/pedagogy.jsonl 2026-07-30 note for elf-b14-002 renames "Alastair Quennell->Callum Illingsby (real Quennell writing family)" and "Ambrey->Vennerby (real UK firms Ambrey Ltd, Ambrey Baker)"; the las-b14-001 note renames "Hyttfallets bruk -> Vresfallets bruk" etc. My WebSearch budget for this session was exhausted (200/200), so I could neither confirm nor clear "M. Tannerfeldt"; "Tannerfeldt" is a real, if uncommon, Swedish surname carried by published Swedish researchers, which is exactly the initial-plus-surname citation shape used here.
findings.why: Unverified rather than demonstrated, so it is filed as a re-check item and not as a refutation. No key or rationale turns on the byline and the passage makes no claim about a real person, so it does not block ship — but the sweeping 'all entities are fictional' claim in generator_meta should rest on a search that someone actually ran against this name.
